verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing claims "granular user permissions" alongside card limits and spend controls, and says built-in permissions let an accountant make payments. Organization-level approval policies can gate payments before release. However, all of this is high-level marketing or approval-flow material, with no documentation of defining custom roles or scoping permissions by location or department. Missing for 10: documented role definitions or custom roles, permission scoping by location or department, an admin docs page describing the permission model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
